sub_graphs.title: Cancun KECCAK256: Hash Computation Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the runtime behavior of the KECCAK256 opcode from input to hash output

nodes.label: KECCAK256 Opcode Received
nodes.description: EVM has decoded KECCAK256 instruction, ready to execute

nodes.label: Pop Memory Parameters
nodes.description: Pop two values from stack: memory start index and data size

nodes.label: Memory Parameters Retrieved
nodes.description: Start index and size values available for memory access

nodes.label: Expand Memory if Needed
nodes.description: Expand EVM memory if requested region exceeds current allocation

nodes.label: Read Memory Region
nodes.description: Read bytes from memory starting at offset for specified size

nodes.label: Data Loaded from Memory
nodes.description: Byte sequence to be hashed is available

nodes.label: Compute Keccak-256 Hash
nodes.description: Apply Keccak-256 cryptographic hash function to data bytes

nodes.label: Hash Computed
nodes.description: 32-byte Keccak-256 hash result available

nodes.label: Push Hash to Stack
nodes.description: Push 32-byte hash result onto EVM stack as U256

nodes.label: KECCAK256 Execution Complete
nodes.description: Hash on stack, PC incremented, execution continues

sub_graphs.title: Cancun KECCAK256: Gas Cost Calculation
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas consumption calculation for KECCAK256 including base, word, and memory expansion costs

nodes.label: Gas Calculation Initiated
nodes.description: KECCAK256 execution started, need to calculate total gas cost

nodes.label: Calculate Word Count
nodes.description: Compute ceiling(size/32) to determine number of 32-byte words

nodes.label: Compute Base Gas Cost
nodes.description: Apply GAS_KECCAK256 constant as base cost

nodes.label: Compute Word Gas Cost
nodes.description: Multiply word count by GAS_KECCAK256_WORD

nodes.label: Compute Memory Expansion Cost
nodes.description: Calculate additional gas if memory needs expansion beyond current size

nodes.label: Sum Total Gas Cost
nodes.description: Add base + word cost + memory expansion = total gas

nodes.label: Total Gas Cost Determined
nodes.description: Final gas cost computed and ready to charge

nodes.label: Charge Gas
nodes.description: Deduct total gas from available gas

nodes.label: Gas Successfully Charged
nodes.description: Sufficient gas was available, execution proceeds

nodes.label: Out of Gas Error
nodes.description: Insufficient gas, execution halts

sub_graphs.title: Cancun KECCAK256: Input Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation checks for KECCAK256 stack and memory access

nodes.label: KECCAK256 Pending Validation
nodes.description: Opcode received, validation checks needed

nodes.label: Validate Stack Depth
nodes.description: Check stack has at least 2 elements for pop, and space for result push

nodes.label: Stack Validation Passed
nodes.description: Stack has sufficient elements and room

nodes.label: Stack Underflow Error
nodes.description: Insufficient elements on stack for offset/size

nodes.label: Validate Memory Access
nodes.description: Check memory access bounds and expansion feasibility

nodes.label: Memory Access Valid
nodes.description: Memory region accessible or expandable

ambiguities.text: The specification does not explicitly state behavior for size=0 (hashing empty data)
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume size=0 is valid and returns the Keccak-256 hash of empty input (known constant value)

ambiguities.text: Memory expansion behavior for very large size values is not explicitly bounded in this module
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume gas cost for memory expansion provides natural DoS protection, as expansion cost grows quadratically

implicit_assumptions.description: The Keccak-256 implementation is cryptographically secure and collision-resistant
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Hash collisions could break smart contract logic relying on unique hashes for storage keys, event signatures, or cryptographic proofs

implicit_assumptions.description: Memory expansion gas cost prevents abuse of unbounded memory allocation
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attackers could cause memory exhaustion DoS if expansion cost is insufficient
